description: Price a rental without committing: creates a free, non-binding AmpleRun quote (valid 60 seconds; nothing is reserved or charged) for a template on an offer, capped by budget_micro. Returns the quote exactly as the API sent it plus fee_split: the most the rental can cost and how that divides into the platform fee (platform_fee_bps) and the host's share. Needs AMPLERUN_API_KEY with the renter scope. create_rental quotes again when it reserves, so this step is optional.

asset.description: Balance to pay from. USDC when omitted.

budget_micro.description: Spending cap in micro-units of the asset ("1000000" = 1 USDC). The rental is never charged more than this.

duration_limit_s.description: Maximum runtime in seconds (60 to 31536000), e.g. 7200 for two hours.

template.description: Template slug such as "pytorch-cuda", or its id (UUID), from list_templates.

name: get_quote
title: Get a rental quote
